sources.description: geo.admin.ch is the geographical information platform of the Swiss Confederation within the Federal Administration. The usage is free but throttled to a maximum amount of requests per time. It is possible though to obtain higher API priviliges by submitting an application.

getaddress.io is a limited free-to-use, commercial API service for UK addresses.
API key is needed: Please check API documentation for details and use API Registration to obtain a key.

Adresses Québec is a geodatabase resulting from a government partnership and collaboration with municipalities. It was created using the expertise and government mission data of its partners.
For more information, visit mrnf.gouv.qc.ca.

The National Occupational Classification (NOC) is Canada’s national system for describing occupations.You can search the NOC to find where an occupation is classified or to learn about its main duties, educational requirements or other useful information.

SOCcer (Standardized Occupation Coding for Computer-assisted Epidemiological Research) is a publicly available application that was developed to assist epidemiological researchers incorporate occupational and industrial risk into their studies. The application is not intended to replace expert coders, but rather prioritizes job descriptions that would most benefit from expert coders. Low scoring job descriptions are more likely to require expert review than high scoring job description.
If you would like to add your own API please make a Pull Request via Github. More information can be found in the docs.
